notes: Quick CRM notes: mid-market product org building AI-first search + support features. Evaluating Hosted API for fast time-to-value; POC proved functional but cost at scale is main pain. Now moving to Dedicated to stabilize unit economics and guarantee capacity. Key ask: detailed capacity sizing (QPS -> GPU nodes), traffic forecast guidance, and model routing policies. Quotes from VP Product: "Need predictable latency & cost per ticket; cannot have unplanned invoice shocks." SE ask: ability to run canary on dedicated pool and fallback to hosted during incidents.
requirements_summary: Workload: chat-heavy support assistant + embeddings/reranking for product search. Latency target: p95 < 250ms for short prompts, p95 < 1s acceptable for summarization; throughput target: baseline 100 QPS, peak bursts up to 200 QPS. Concurrency goal: 60 concurrent streams. Token mix: 70% short (40–60), 20% mid (200–400), 10% long (>2000). Cost sensitivity: high — prefer lower per-token cost via batching/quantization for embeddings and rerank. Model preferences: Llama2-70B-8q/Redwood-verified open models for primary, smaller quantized variant for low-cost fallback. Routing/fallback: region-aware routing, model-variant fallback when Dedicated pool at capacity. Security: VPC + SSO + KMS + audit logs required. POC ask: compute sizing recommendation (GPU count + memory) and pricing breakdown for 100/150/200 QPS scenarios.
sales_playbook_notes: Host demo -> Hosted trial -> POC with telemetry -> pricing + dedicated sizing workshop -> legal/MSA -> procurement. Focus on: cost model transparency, autoscaling/burst policy, rollout (canary/A-B), and observability (per-token cost deltas). Highlight Optimize for batching/caching suggestions to reduce unit cost.
